title: Evaluation of a strict enriched face cocone along an admissible splitting
statement: Use the small simplicial categories of [lem-coef-simplicial-interval-lifting] and the ordered subset-poset coherent simplices of [lem-coef-pinched-cube-latching]. Let $V$ be a finite nonempty linearly ordered set and $D$ a small simplicial category. A strict face cocone consists of a family $\mathcal F$ of nonempty subsets of $V$, containing every singleton and closed under nonempty subsets, and enriched functors $f_F:\mathfrak C[\Delta^F]\to D$ for $F\in\mathcal F$, such that $f_F=f_G\circ\mathfrak C[F\hookrightarrow G]$ for every inclusion of members. Put $d_v=f_{\{v\}}(v)$. For $i<j$, $q\geq0$, a flag $S$ is a $q$-simplex of the nerve of endpoint-containing subsets of $[i,j]$, equivalently $S_0\subseteq\cdots\subseteq S_q$ with $i,j\in S_t\subseteq[i,j]$. A splitting is a finite subset $R=\{i=a_0<\cdots<a_r=j\}\subseteq S_0$, represented by its increasing enumeration. It is canonical when $R=S_0$. Its block support is $T_b=S_q\cap[a_{b-1},a_b]$; it is admissible when every $T_b\in\mathcal F$. Restricting $S$ to that block gives the flag $(S_t\cap[a_{b-1},a_b])_{t=0}^q$ in $\mathfrak C[\Delta^{T_b}](a_{b-1},a_b)_q$. Its image under $f_{T_b}$ is identified with an element of $D(d_{a_{b-1}},d_{a_b})_q$ using strict singleton-face compatibility. Define $E_R(S)\in D(d_i,d_j)_q$ as the composite of these block images in increasing order. The simplicial restriction $\alpha^*S$ for a monotone $\alpha:[p]\to[q]$ is the flag $(S_{\alpha(t)})_{t=0}^p$, using the nerve operators.

lean.note: Explicit constructions for strict face-cocone evaluation. No theorem or sorry occurs here. Ordered subsets use Mathlib SimplicialThickening.Path and ComposableArrows; endpoint normalization is forced by strict singleton compatibility. The definitions also cover arbitrary ambient linear orders and endpoint pairs, so the stated finite strict-endpoint case is included without an extra assumption.
